comment:
* Helper for accessing features in {@link android.os.UserManager}
 * introduced after API level 4 in a backwards compatible fashion.

methods.name: public static boolean isUserRunningAndLocked(Context context)
methods.comment:
* Return whether the calling user is running in a "locked" state. A user is
     * unlocked only after they've entered their credentials (such as a lock
     * pattern or PIN), and credential-encrypted private app data storage is
     * available.
     *
     * @removed

methods.name: public static boolean isUserRunningAndUnlocked(Context context)
methods.comment:
* Return whether the calling user is running in an "unlocked" state. A user
     * is unlocked only after they've entered their credentials (such as a lock
     * pattern or PIN), and credential-encrypted private app data storage is
     * available.
     *
     * @removed

methods.name: public static boolean isUserUnlocked(Context context)
methods.comment:
* Return whether the calling user is running in an "unlocked" state. A user
     * is unlocked only after they've entered their credentials (such as a lock
     * pattern or PIN), and credential-encrypted private app data storage is
     * available.
